paragraphs: Rivas Super Salon is a full-service salon and barbershop at 1407 N. Frazier in Conroe, offering everything from classic haircuts and beard work to perms, keratin treatments, extensions, and color.
Our team is bilingual — English and Spanish spoken — so every client feels at home in the chair. Walk in for a quick trim or book ahead for a full transformation.

location.title: Rivas Super Salon
paragraphs: 1407 N. Frazier St, Conroe, TX 77301 — free on-site parking right out front.
Walk-ins are always welcome, and appointments get priority. Call or text ahead to check the wait.

faq.q: Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
faq.a: Both work! Walk-ins are always welcome, but appointments get priority, especially on weekends. Call or text ahead if you want to check the wait.

faq.q: Can I pay in person instead of online?
faq.a: Of course. You're welcome to pay in person with cash or card — booking or paying online is just an option for those who'd rather reserve ahead.

faq.q: I want to bring my own hair extensions — can you install them?
faq.a: Yes! We install client-provided extensions using the wax method (lasts about 2–3 months), braided-in, or keratin bond. Just let us know your preferred method when you book, in the notes.
Sí! Our team is fully bilingual. Call or text (936) 529-6735 for Spanish, or (936) 224-9442 for English.
